caption: We suffer more in our heads than we ever do in reality…
transcript: We suffer more in our heads than we ever do in reality. There is the world that is actually happening. Conversations, actions, small mistakes, ordinary days. And then there is the world inside your mind. The imagined arguments, the worst case endings, the silent assumptions about what people must be thinking. In reality, maybe they just haven't replied yet. In your mind, they lost interest, found someone better, decided you were not enough. In reality, you made a small mistake. In your mind, you destroyed your future forever. The brain is powerful. It tries to protect you by predicting pain. But often, it creates pain that has not even happened. Intuition is quiet. Fear is loud. Fear demands urgency. Wisdom asks you to pause. When you feel yourself spiraling, breathe and ask, is this truly happening? Or is this a story I'm telling myself? Most of the time, reality is gentler than imagination. We do not always suffer from life itself. We suffer from the story we attach to it. If this spoke to you, follow for more wisdom and comment, and peace so your heart remembers what is real.
